identity.description: Ramp is a finance automation platform (corporate cards, spend management, bill pay, reimbursements) for businesses. Its developer API lives at docs.ramp.com and developer-docs.ramp.com (redirects to docs.ramp.com).
identity.identity_notes: The Ramp Help Center and Ramp docs describe the Ramp finance product and its Developer API and MCP server. Not confused with Ramp Network (docs.rampnetwork.com), a separate crypto on-ramp company.

auth.oauth_flows: Client Credentials (server-to-server, for your own Ramp business); Authorization Code (third-party apps granted by other Ramp businesses) with Refresh Token. Token endpoint: {environment-url}/developer/v1/token. Client credentials are sent as HTTP Basic auth (client_id:client_secret) or in the form body.
auth.token_refresh: Client Credentials tokens last 10 days (864,000 seconds) and return no refresh token; request a new one on expiry. Authorization Code and Refresh Token access tokens default to 1 hour; refresh with grant_type=refresh_token (no new refresh token returned).
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes follow resource:permission, e.g. transactions:read. Omitting scope yields a token with no scopes. Each endpoint's API reference lists required scopes; some endpoints also need a Ramp plan feature and return 403 without it.

access.production_restrictions: Publishing an app for other Ramp businesses requires two approvals including a partner application and production access application via the Developer console. Using the API within your own business does not appear to require this. Sandbox access is requested via a form at docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/sandbox-access; whether that form is approval-gated is unknown. Sandbox and production need separate apps; sandbox base is demo.ramp.com and production app.ramp.com for authorize.

resources: Bill Pay / Bills and Bill Payments
read_ops: Search/retrieve transactions (per Quickstart and CLI guide)
write_ops: Create approved bills, attach documents, choose payment method, pay vendors
api.rate_limits: unknown: rate-limiting guide exists (docs.ramp.com/llms-guides/rate-limiting.txt) but its numbers were not retrieved. Requests over 60 seconds return 504.
api.limitations: Endpoint-level list and read/write split were not fully verified; full OpenAPI at /openapi/developer-api.json and /llms-api.txt were not fetched. Some endpoints need a specific Ramp plan feature. No official SDK was found in sources. Vendors not confirmed as standalone resource.
